title: A two-sided error bound for spectral functions from sample-based quantum diagonalization — reproduction repository
description: Reproduction deposit for N. Bonilla Vargas, A two-sided error bound for spectral functions from sample-based quantum diagonalization, the manuscript prepared for The Journal of Chemical Physics (deposit 3.5.0, 2026-11-18; an earlier version of the manuscript is arXiv:2608.16436, whose version 4 is carried by deposit 3.4.1). It contains the manuscript sources and the two PDFs built from them (main text and Supplementary Material), the computation scripts, the deposited data behind the figures and the quoted numbers (with the re-scoring of every number that depends on the second-order branch of Theorem 1, from the stored data), and an automated guardian (python src/verify.py, 1,269 checks over 16,565 numeric assertions) that recomputes the underlying physics by exact diagonalization and checks the deposit against it; the parts that are not reproducible from the deposit (the regeneration of three figure rasters, the raw hardware counts, the pyscf-dependent recomputation) are listed in docs/KNOWN_DISCREPANCIES.md. Code under the MIT licence; manuscript, data and documentation under CC BY 4.0.
